hashToolContract: Caller supplies an existing absolute executable path with the shasum -a 256 -- interface. Freeze it before hashing; record selected path and tool SHA. Missing/invalid input refuses rather than falling back to a fixed system binary; batch validation retains exact paths and all before/after file checks
ownership: Gambit owns independent native CI and fixtures. SMP owns SysML, ASCENT, QNT/Lean links, Org, D2 and evidence; no parent-repository runtime dependency.
proofOwnership: Existing CS-SCHEDULE QNT owns ordering and permit histories; CS-COHERENCE Lean owns issued-view algebra. Source adapters and native observations do not duplicate either theorem.
bootstrapContract: One exact-source two-pass bootstrap, original 600-second wall budget; no heap increase, patch import or timeout extension. CI runs modules against its single bootstrapped checkout; local research may use an authenticated existing producer without making a cold-CI claim.
failureCustody: Unknown or failed origins retain roots and native resources; missing native observations remain open. CI definitions are not remote CI acceptance.
